mostWorthwhile.text: The storage-and-release sequence was most worthwhile: it connects portal nutrients to glycogen storage and glucose supply between meals, with clear planned picture descriptions.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate blood-transport step felt somewhat repetitive after the liver was already shown releasing glucose, although it clarified the destination.

surprise.text: The final picture plan connected digestion to nerves and lymph as well as blood, but did not explain those particular connections in detail.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though using a separate blood-transport item to carry released glucose felt slightly mechanical.

continue.text: I would continue: connecting the liver’s glucose storage to the wider body was useful, and I would be curious to see other systems integrated with similar explanations.
